LEGER.gloss: a record in which commercial accounts are recorded
LEGER.definition: A record in which commercial accounts are recorded.
LEGER.example: They got a subpoena to examine our books.

REEL.gloss: walk as if unable to control one's movements
REEL.definition: Walk as if unable to control one's movements.
REEL.example: The drunken man staggered into the room.

GEL.gloss: a colloid in a more solid form than a sol
GEL.definition: A colloid in a more solid form than a sol.

GEE.gloss: a unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity
GEE.definition: A unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity; used to indicate the force to which a body is subjected when it is accelerated.

LEE.gloss: the side of something that is sheltered from the wind
LEE.definition: The side of something that is sheltered from the wind.

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.
